answer: To resist sybil attacks in an agent economy, each participant must prove ownership of a unique physical quartz token that is laser-etched with a spiral pattern encoding a one-time secret derived from a personal fable only the owner knows. Replicating this for thousands of fake identities forces an attacker to source and engrave thousands of distinct quartz pieces, creating prohibitive material and labor costs that scale linearly with the number of sybils, while honest agents need only one.
